The input fields have subtle gray borders and light backgrounds for clarity and usability. Below each input is concise helper text in small gray font providing guidance.

The right column is a receipt preview panel framed with a light gray border. It displays the order details in a structured vertical layout: order ID, order date (Jan 7, 2026), and total price ($2) aligned in a small info section. Below this is a product thumbnail image on the left, with product title (truncated with ellipsis), seller's name with an avatar icon, and a black rectangular "View content" button centered below, consistent with the button text input. Spacing is generous with 16-24px padding around input fields and container edges, and consistent vertical margins between elements. The layout uses a 2-column grid with the sidebar occupying about 20% width, main content 60%, and the preview panel 20%, separated by subtle lines or background differences. Overall style is minimalistic, functional, and professional, emphasizing usability and content clarity. There are no visible animations.
content.layout:

The main area is split into two adjacent columns: the left content panel and the right preview panel. The left content panel contains vertically stacked input form elements with labels and helper text, arranged in a single vertical column with consistent spacing. The right preview panel is a narrow vertical area with boxed sections stacked vertically, including order details, product info (image and text aligned horizontally), a button, product price, payment info text block, address, and branding. Padding and margins separate these blocks and align text left with some centered elements (like buttons).

Users can customize the text on the download button visible on receipts and product pages by entering their preferred button label in the "Button text" input field. They can also add any extra personalized message or information they want to appear on the receipt using the multi-line "Custom message" text area. The interface provides real-time visual feedback with a preview panel on the right showing how the receipt will look with the changes, including order details, product info, and the button label.

The sidebar allows navigating between various related sections like Products, Checkout, Emails, and Sales, thus integrating receipt customization within a broader product management context.

The overall purpose of the screen is to empower product creators on Gumroad to tailor the customer receipt experience to their brand and communication style efficiently, enhancing the purchase process transparency and customer engagement by ensuring receipts contain clear, relevant, and personalized content.

Below the header, the content area is divided into a title 'My Classes' with a tab navigation bar containing 'All Saved Classes', 'My Learning Paths', 'My Lists', and 'Watch History'. The active tab 'All Saved Classes' is underlined in green. Filters are provided horizontally including checkboxes for 'Class Length' (<15 min, 15–30 min, 30–60 min, >60 min) and 'Status' (Not yet started, In progress, Completed), plus a horizontal skills dropdown and tags area with items such as 'Creative', 'Marketing', 'Business', 'Animation', and 'Motion Graphics'. Below the filters is a vertical list of class cards. Each card displays a small rectangular thumbnail image with a play icon overlay on the left, next to course info including the title in bold, instructor name, class duration, and number of students enrolled. On the far right of each card is a vertical ellipsis icon indicating more options. Some class thumbnails have colored progress bars at their bottom edges. The footer is a dark navy blue bar divided into four columns: Company, Community, Teaching, and Mobile. These contain links to various informational pages and app download badges for Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Social media icons and language selector are aligned to the right in the footer. The layout is responsive and spaced with generous padding, maintaining a multi-column grid in footer and well-aligned rows in the class list, enhancing scan-ability and user interaction. No animations are visible in the static images provided.
content.layout: The page layout has a fixed horizontal header at the top with a dark navy background, spanning full width. The header contains three main sections horizontally aligned: left (logo and main navigation), center (search bar), right (user actions and profile). Below the header, the main content area uses a vertical columnar layout with a prominent heading at top left. Directly below is a horizontal tab bar with four clickable tabs arranged in a single row with equal spacing, the active one underlined with a colored border. Under the tabs, filters are placed horizontally in two groups aligned left and spaced evenly: class length checkboxes and status checkboxes. Beneath these checkboxes is a skill selection area with a dropdown menu and several skill filter pills arranged horizontally, wrapping if needed. The main class list is arranged as a vertical list with each entry displayed as a horizontal card spanning nearly the full width. Each card has a left-aligned thumbnail image, center-aligned textual information in multiple lines, and a right-aligned icon menu. Cards include progress bars below the thumbnail in some cases. The footer is divided into four vertical columns with headings and link lists, aligned horizontally across the footer area, which is full-width and colored dark navy. Social icons and language selector are aligned right at the bottom. The layout uses generous padding and spacing for clarity and visual balance, with logical grouping and alignment to facilitate scanning and interaction.
content.functions: Users can browse their saved or enrolled classes, filter them by duration, status, and skills to find relevant or desired courses quickly. The filter checkboxes and skill tags provide easy ways to refine the course list visually, with clear labels and active states for selected filters. Users can navigate between tabs to see different collections such as learning paths, lists, or watch history. Each course card supports viewing key info at a glance—title, instructor, duration, enrollment. The play icon on thumbnails suggests users can click to watch or preview the course. The vertical ellipsis on each card indicates additional actions (e.g., remove, save for later, or share), supporting class management. The search bar in the header allows users to find other classes, skills, or teachers globally. The global navigation guides users to main platform areas. The footer provides supplementary navigation to company info, community features, teaching resources, and mobile app downloads. The interface facilitates task workflow from discovering, filtering, managing, and accessing educational content to personalized account management. Overall, the page supports efficient course tracking and learning progress, helping users organize and engage in their educational activities.

content.description: The screen features a clean, minimalist dashboard style interface with a left sidebar navigation area and a main content area on the right. The sidebar uses a dark background (#1E1E1E or similar) with white text and icons in a vertical column. It is divided into sections separated by subtle lines or spacing. The top area displays 'Liam's School' as a heading in white. Below are navigation items with icons and labels: Home, Users, Site, Sales, Emails, App Hub, Settings. Then a PRODUCTS section has items: Courses, Coaching, Digital Downloads, Community, Memberships, Bundles, Plan, all in white text with matching icons. The main content area has a white background (#FFFFFF) and black text (#000000). At the top right, there is a notification bell icon with a red badge showing count 0, and a 'View Your School' button with border and text in black on white background. The header says 'Welcome, Liam!' in bold font. Below is a section titled 'Create your course outline' in a large serif font, with a smaller subheading explaining usage. Input fields with placeholders: 'Give it a name' (Course title) and a large multiline text area with placeholder for course description are placed below in a vertical stack. Both fields have subtle grey borders (#CCCCCC) and rounded corners. A bright yellow button (#E4FF00) labeled 'Generate your outline' is below the inputs, with black bold text, rectangular shape and subtle rounding. Under this, a section titled 'Other ways to get started' uses a smaller bold serif font. Below are three rectangular cards arranged horizontally featuring additional resource links and images, each with a label and brief description. The left card contains bullet points (Design files, Ebooks, Email templates, Newsletters, How to guides, Spreadsheets, Podcasts, Recipes) on a pastel pink background (#FBEFFF). Next to it are two cards with screenshots and images showcasing platform features or tutorials. In the second image, there are three feature explanation boxes arranged horizontally with white backgrounds, each containing a bold heading with an icon, descriptive text below, and a rectangular button below: 'Create a digital download', 'Create a community', 'Create a coaching service'. Below is a 'Tips' section with three cards horizontally aligned, each with a title in bold, an icon, descriptive text, and a button (Enroll here, Hire an expert, Download guide). The overall typography is a clean serif for headings with sizes about 24-28 px for main titles, and a clean sans-serif for body text at roughly 14-16 px. The interface spacing is generous with consistent vertical rhythm and left alignment for text areas, with padding around inputs and cards. The style is functional, modern, and uncluttered with focus on usability and clarity.
content.layout: The layout uses a two-column structure: a fixed vertical left sidebar occupying about 20% width with navigation elements stacked vertically, and a main content column occupying about 80% width to the right with multiple stacked sections. Within the main content area, the topmost header is aligned left with a welcoming message and a top-right aligned button and notification icon. Below, the course outline creation section is a vertical form with labeled input fields arranged in single columns, followed by a horizontally laid out group of three cards in a row under 'Other ways to get started'. Further down, there's a full-width block split equally into three horizontally aligned boxes for digital download, community, and coaching with buttons below. At the bottom is a tips section with three equal-width cards in one horizontal row. Ample padding and margins separate each section vertically, and content is aligned mostly left and center globally. The use of grid or flexbox style horizontal rows for the resource cards and tips cards is evident. The left sidebar uses vertical stacking with icons and text aligned left. The design emphasizes clarity, simplicity, and user focus through balanced spacing and clear visual hierarchy.
content.functions: Users can enter the course title and a detailed course description in provided input fields to create a personalized course outline. The input fields support text entry with placeholders guiding what to enter. Upon filling these, users can click the prominent 'Generate your outline' button to trigger AI-powered creation of curriculum, lesson content, and sales page outlines, thereby automating course creation workflows. Additionally, users can explore other ways to get started by interacting with resource cards offering files, guides, ebooks, templates, and podcasts, helping to inspire or aid course building. In the second section, users can create a digital download, build a community, or start a coaching service by clicking the respective action buttons. The tips section invites users to enroll in a sales mini course, hire experts to assist with course marketing, or download guides with digital product ideas, providing educational support. Overall, this interface facilitates comprehensive course management and creation, supporting beginners and creators to set up, plan, and grow their educational products effectively by combining direct input collection, AI generation, actionable resources, and expert guidance options.
